headline: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited: Committee of Creditors Constituted in CIRP
sum: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited, a listed sugar company, has notified the Constitution of a Committee of Creditors (CoC) as part of its Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process, signalling entry into the formal CIRP phase under IBC 2016.
detail: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited, a sugar and agro-allied company with BSE/NSE listings, has formally constituted its Committee of Creditors following admission of a corporate insolvency petition. The CoC comprises representatives of all categories of creditors (financial creditors, operational creditors, and government dues holders where applicable) and is mandated to approve the appointment of an Insolvency Resolution Professional (IRP), oversee claims adjudication, and approve any Resolution Plan. This milestone indicates the company has cleared the threshold eligibility checks under IBC section 4 and Schedule II, and the CoC is now empowered to negotiate, evaluate and vote on Resolution Plans submitted by prospective bidders.
